notes:
**General Round Advice** - 
For this round my advice is pretty simple. I tend to focus on mostly just staying alive and building ultimate as quickly and as SAFELY as I can. Staying alive is very important as a support because if you die, everyone else most likely will. This is especially important when playing stadium as Mercy because a lot of times your other support will probably be doing a more DPS focused build, so you may be the main (or even only) healer a lot of times.  Your amount of deaths also affects your stadium cash, so the more deaths you avoid then the more cash you will farm. Just stay alive and heal to the best of your abilities. It's as simple as that.


**'Serenity' + 'First Aid Kit'** - 
This is a great combo for staying alive early in the game. I think the self healing and lower health regen work really nicely together when you still have low HP.

**'Weapon Grease' + 'Compensator'** - 
I always go for these two on my first rounds, no matter what build I am going for. It's great for pumping out heals faster and can help you build ultimate quicker, which is good for cash farming as Mercy.

notes:
**General Round Advice** - 
For this round, you basically want to do the same as before, but with slightly better stats. If you have enough cash, keep your items from round one and add the newly recommended ones along side them. If not, that's okay. You'll still do fine with the upgraded items, but I would be sure to keep 'First Aid Kit'.


**'Talon Modification Module' + 'Compensator'** - 
For Mercy, better weapon power equals better healing, so try to mainly go for that.

**'Aftermarket Firing Pin' + 'Weapon Grease'** - 
It's important to not ONLY focus on weapon power, but ALSO attack speed. A good balance between the two can easily outshine a build focused solely on one or the other. On a similar note, I have seen MANY cases where a 1v1 will happen and the one that utilizes them both most often tends to be the one that lives.

**'First Aid Kit'** - 
We will upgrade this soon, but for now since we have 'Serenity', I wouldn't be too worried. Just play smarter about your positioning and when NOT to rez and you'll be good as gold.

notes:
**General Round Advice** - 
Round 3 is when this build starts to pick up a little momentum. Still try to mainly focus on heals. This build is great for giving you DPS opportunities when it's needed, but it is till mainly healing based. I recommend starting to do damage during your ultimate now that you have 'Crepuscular Circle', but I wouldn't recommend doing it any other time just yet. Don't get greedy with your damage, when the time comes, it will come.


**'Crepuscular Circle'** - 
I LOVE this power. it is SERIOUSLY amazing at farming stadium cash for Mercy. It automatically applies healing AND damage boost to all nearby allies, so your able to DPS to your heart's content. I only don't recommend it as a starting power because you don't really get as much bang for your buck until round three and you want to be healing heavy in the first rounds anyways. Just remember, don't get greedy with damage. Only pull out your gun during ultimate and if ABSOLUETLY necessary. This power is very strong, but you still need to be smart and not throw all caution to the wind.

**'Talon Modification Module' + 'Icy Coolant'** - 
Once again, better weapon power equals better heals. You really aren't going to change too much this round, just add on to what you already have.

**'Aftermarket Firing Pin' + 'Weapon Grease'** - 
Extra attack speed is great. Once again, you are simply adding on to what you have for now.

**'First Aid Kit' + 'Armored Vest'** - 
NOW we will had on some armor. You don't really need too much health stuff yet, as long as you're smart, but everyone is slowly getting stronger and armor is stronger than shield, so you want to go ahead and add that on. Like I said, just be smart and stay alive to the best of your abilities. Your power from round one should easily help with that.

notes:
**General Round Advice** - 
Things are starting to get a little heavier out on the field. With your newly upgraded items, don't be afraid to pull your gun out now. Still show some refrain and mostly keep it for your ultimate, but every now and then doesn't hurt. If you see the opportunity to dps, go for it, but if your team needs you then your team needs you. At this point your ultimate should start getting pretty dang good, so you should be able to farm some pretty good cash for next round's upgrades.


**'Booster Jets'** - 
Go ahead and swap out your two attack speed items for this one. Not only does it give you slightly more attack speed, but it also frees up some space for another item. Just a generally good decision in my opinion. I go for this one as my first epic item, due to the fact that we already have decent weapon power. 

**'Talon Modification Module' + 'Icy Coolant'** - 
Keep these two items, they're generally good at getting the job done. You don't really need more weapon power yet, so hold out on that and use your cash elsewhere.

**'Meka Z-Series' + 'Vital-E-Tee' + 'Armored Vest'** - 
Things are starting to get wild in the battlefield, so upgrading your survivability is a must in this round. These items are really good for getting a larger health pool and giving you some much needed armor. Armor is a lot better than shield, so by this point we will be going full armor, as opposed to the shields we were using previously. I feel there are a lot of times that having even just a little bit of armor has saved me from certain death, so it's great to have. This should get you to about 357 HP, which is pretty good for now along with our round one power.

notes:
**General Round Advice** - 
Now the fight at this point is REAL. This round you will get your weapon power and attack speed to a nice 40/20 percentage and keep it that way until the final round (if the game lasts that long I mean). This is a pretty solid balance for Mercy so I would not worry about taking your gun out more often to help out with team fights. At this point your team mates should have some pretty decent health items, so don't be afraid to help with damage if it is needed. Don't completely forget healing, but you are now in a pretty dang good position to DPS more, while keeping your team alive. Your round 5 power also enables you to DPS more, as it activates your ultimate every time you successfully rez someone. This is not only good for doing damage, but also greatly enables your team.


**'Renaissance'** - 
This power is strongly recommended to go along with your round two power. It gives you more uptime on you ultimate and enables you AND your teammates while you are recovering from being down a team member. If you are having a hard time pulling of rezzes then you can always save this power for round seven and instead go for [First Responder](item_30a5c70f-e0b5-489a-96ae-900f34c3823d) this round. The extra ultimate is fantastic to have, but it does no good if you aren't able to pull the rez off completely without dying.

**'Booster Jets'** - 
You will be keeping this item form here on out. I generally tend to keep my attack speed at 20% as I feel there are better upgrades to be made and you've already got plenty at this point. I never really go higher on attack speed, unless I feel like i'm not getting heals out fast enough. I generally do not recommend going any higher than this though.

**'Eye of the Spider' + 'Talon Modification Module'** - 
This upgrade it great for better heals. If you feel that higher weapon power isn't as necessary, you can always go for [Caduceus Ex](item_9e7965ea-2abc-44a7-b042-950c6ad2fce7). It is also a great alternative, if you feel like you need to back away from the team fight for a bit, due to excessive deaths or being targeted. It still gives you 10% weapon power, which is great, but I tend to go for the more weapon power option if I am staying alive well enough.

**'Rustung Von Wilhelm' + 'Meka Z-Series' + 'Vital-E-Tee'** - 
At this point, we will need to get 'Rustung'. It gives you more health and armor, which is, of course, awesome. Things are getting heavier as the rounds progress, so staying alive will get harder. this makes good health items a necessity. This should put you at 432 HP, which is pretty good. Congrats, you are officially becoming the tanky Mercy of every Mercy players' dreams.

notes:
**General Round Advice** - 
By this point in the game you should be ROLLING in cash. You may not have as much as I did when I made this build, but that is completely fine, you should still have a lot to go around due to your freaking awesome ultimate. Advice is pretty much the same as before, keep your team alive, but DO NOT be afraid to Battle Mercy if you see fit. This build is meant to allow you to have the versatility of being able to utilize both playstyles. 


**Booster Jets** - 
Like I said, you will keeping this until end game. It's just generally good to have for both healing and damaging.

**Eye of the Spider + Amari's Antidote** - 
All the weapon power you will need. I recommend going for 'Amari's Antidote' due to the weapon power AND extra health. Pretty nice to have, especially so late in the game when everyone is almost at their strongest.

**Rustung Von Wilhelm + Ogundimu Reduction Field + Vital-E-Tee** - 
If you follow this build exactly, by now you should have 511 HP. This is great, considering how strong everyone is. 'Ogundimu' is especially great due to its damage reduction. Many players recommend this item and for good reason, it is pretty dang good at keeping you alive. You are quite tanky at this point so you can make riskier plays, but still remember to be smart. YOU ARE STRONG,  BUT NOT UNKILLABLE. I believe in you though. :)

notes:
**General Round Advice** - 
Unfortunately, this round you will probably not have as much agency as the previous rounds. This goes not just for Mercy and this build, but for any support character and build. Up until this point you could have been completely steam rolling the competition and this round will still be pretty tricky. Round seven is difficult because EVERYONE has good powers and items now, not just the leading team. Unfortunately this means that you will have to sort of just do your personal best and hope that your team is doing the same. I wish you the best of luck, fellow Mercy. I believe in you.


**First Responder** - 
If you didn't opt for this power in round five when I suggested it as a alternative then you probably want to pick this up now. This gives you and the revived teammate overhealth of 250 HP (this scales with AP, but I don't go that route) for 6 seconds. This allows you to pull of riskier rezzes and gives you both a higher chance of making it out alive. This is especially useful as you now have overhealth during your 5 second ultimate you get from rezzes and you can do quite a bit with that. It's not the most overhealth you COULD get, but it is still a substantial enough amount that makes this power worth it for me. Especially during the last round where rezzes are going to be a lot harder to pull off.

**Booster Jets** - 
Still a good item to have. I wouldn't ever give it up for another item.

**Eye of the Spider + Amari's Antidote** - 
You should keep both of these. If you have the cash and you think you can get away with slightly less health then you can swap 'Amari's Antidote' out for something with higher weapon power. This is up to you and depends on the game though.

**Ogundimu Reduction Field + Rustung Von Wilhelm + Chain Evoker** - 
Both of these that you already had are necessary to keep. They will help keep you alive in the hell storm of a fight that is to come in round seven. You will not also add 'Chain Evoker' into the mix. Not only is it 50 extra armor, but it also allows you to get ult charge from damage boost, which is awesome for building your ultimate faster. All in all you should have 549 HP now with overhealth when you rez. This SHOULD get you through the round as long as you aren't a dummy dum and constantly run out into the open. During this round, remember that everyone is going to be out to get you. You are not invincible.
